description: Two slew limiters, each with its own rise time, fall time and curve

params.text: Bends the curve of both stages between straight and exponential
How long the output takes to rise, 0 to 100 seconds
How long the output takes to fall, 0 to 100 seconds
Passes the input straight through without slewing it

inputs.text: A voltage moving the rise time of that section
A voltage moving the fall time of that section
A trigger switches the bypass on and off
